rationale: LPLA is down ~7.4% on a gap driven by earnings reaction, currently sitting at 15% of today's range near the session low ($270.00) with price drifting lower on the last few 1-minute candles and trading below both VWAP ($277.38) and the 9-EMA ($274.59).
